title: Roof Terraces, Paving & Green Roofs
activity: Roof terraces (paving, porcelain on pedestals) and biodiverse green roofs
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Insulation and filter membrane laid before paving?
Pedestals and rails set out and level per the LPL drawing, joint connector at every pedestal?
Rail cantilever no more than 300 mm from a pedestal; bracing struts in?
questions.source: LDP porcelain ITP 00003 checklist – joist connectors, bracing

questions.q: 4 mm spacer clips at every cruciform; 10 mm gap at edges and balustrade posts?
questions.source: LDP porcelain ITP 00003 checklist – spacers, perimeter gap

questions.q: Wind uplift clips at all tile edges on rails; sealant applied to rails?
questions.source: LDP porcelain ITP 00003 checklist – uplift clips, Seelex FR

questions.q: Tiles/paving level, even joints, no lippage or rocking?
questions.source: LDP porcelain ITP 00003 checklist – paving; ITP 00002 2.6

questions.q: Electronic integrity test done before the green roof goes down?
Drainage boards (20/40 mm) laid with 150 mm fleece overlaps?
Substrate 80–150 mm deep (115 mm average), trims riveted at all connections?
Cobble margins (20–40 mm cobbles) to 75 mm depth around outlets and edges?
